note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 18 November 2026, RealHunt lists 6 homes for sale in Bulgaria, each one checked by a person.
In Bulgaria, the median asking price of those 6 homes is €66,000 (€740 per m², from the 6 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €58,900 and the most expensive €70,000.
Taxes and fees add about 3.2–8.5% to the price of a home in Bulgaria (figures as of 2026).
With 6 homes this is a small sample, so the median for Bulgaria is a rough guide.

buying.costs_breakdown: Transfer tax 0.1-3% (municipal; Sofia 2.5%) + notary 0.1-1.5% + legal 0.5-1% + agent 2.5-3%.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes, buildings and apartments, with rights similar to locals; per GPG, foreigners can't own land directly, so a Bulgarian company is the usual route.
buying.annual_property_tax: 0.01-0.45% of the property's tax value plus a municipal garbage fee.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents: 10% final tax on gross rent, paid quarterly, no deductions.

homes.title: Two-bedroom flat with a panoramic sea view on the first line in Pomorie
homes.title_es: Piso de dos dormitorios con vistas panorámicas al mar en primera línea en Pomorie
homes.summary: An 81 m² flat on the second floor of Sunset Resort in Pomorie, right on the first line by a soft sandy beach, with a panoramic sea view: two bedrooms, a living room with a kitchenette, a walk-in wardrobe, a bathroom and a terrace. Fully furnished and equipped. The resort has four outdoor pools, an indoor pool, a lazy river, children's slides, bars and restaurants. Asking €59,900, about €740/m².

homes.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with a sea view in a gated complex in Kavarna
homes.title_es: Piso amueblado de dos dormitorios con vistas al mar en un complejo cerrado en Kavarna
homes.summary: A spacious 89.5 m² flat on the third floor of a five-storey building in the well-kept gated complex Kavarna Paradise, a 3-minute walk from the beach: an entrance hall, a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, a bathroom and two terraces. South-west facing, bright, with a pleasant sea view. Fully furnished and ready to use with no renovation needed; cable TV and internet. The complex has a pool. Asking €66,000, about €733/m².

homes.title: Two-bedroom flat with two sea-panorama terraces in Kavarna Hills
homes.title_es: Piso de dos dormitorios con dos terrazas con panorámica al mar en Kavarna Hills
homes.summary: A furnished 99.6 m² flat on the fourth of six floors in a 2008 brick building in the Kavarna Hills complex, in the seaside part of town: an entrance hall, a big living-dining room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and two terraces with a lovely sea panorama over the pools and Cape Chirakman. Lift, parking space and two outdoor pools; the sea is three minutes away. Asking €69,000, about €690/m².

homes.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with a sea-view terrace 300 m from the beach in Kavarna
homes.title_es: Piso amueblado de dos dormitorios con terraza con vistas al mar a 300 m de la playa en Kavarna
homes.summary: A 99 m² flat on the fifth of six floors, about 300 m from the beach: a hallway, a spacious living room with a kitchen, two fully equipped bathrooms, two bedrooms, a cellar and two terraces, one with a sea view. Sold with all furniture and appliances (air conditioning, oven, hob, washing machine, fridge), ready to rent out or move in. The complex has two outdoor pools, parking and a play area; maintenance fee €750 a year. Asking €70,000, about €707/m².

homes.title: Sea-view apartment with pool on Bulgaria's Black Sea coast
homes.title_es: Apartamento con vistas al mar y piscina en la costa del mar Negro (Bulgaria)
homes.summary: A finished one-bedroom apartment of 53 m² in a gated complex in Byala, 50 km south of Varna on the Black Sea, with a panoramic terrace looking over the pool and the sea. Entrance hall, living room with kitchenette, bedroom and shower room; sold ready to move in.

homes.title: Ready-to-move-in two-bedroom flat with a sea-view terrace in Kavarna
homes.title_es: Piso de dos dormitorios listo para entrar con terraza con vistas al mar en Kavarna
homes.summary: An 86.5 m² flat on the ground floor of a well-maintained 2007 complex, a 3-minute walk from the beach: an entrance hall, a living room with a fully fitted kitchen and dining area, two furnished bedrooms, a bathroom and a terrace with sea views. South-west exposure brings light all day. Sold fully furnished and equipped, in very good condition with no renovation needed; suits holidays or year-round living. Asking €66,000, about €759/m².
